tool.provenance: The official release checksum table publishes this SHA-1. The cached jar matches it. SHA-256 was computed over those same bytes and is enforced before execution. Java and the jar are never committed.
tool.mode: Breadth-first complete reachable-state exploration. No simulation, depth cutoff, fairness or temporal liveness property. Terminal deadlocks are permitted.

bounds.observer: Any captured subset of visible symbolic records with independent complete/incomplete marker; one final classification, no atomic snapshot promise.

mapping.boundary: Pending open, partial/complete write, atomic hard link, readback and reply. Existing identical canonical destination is represented by set union. Interrupted pending names remain ignored; retry reuses record identity with a fresh pending file. Metadata/readback/unlink are silent under ordinary immutable-file assumptions. Existing-only namespace/export-safety preflight may refuse before pending creation; it adds no canonical effect and is silent under the configured ordinary immutable-directory assumptions. Native folder identity and cloud sync are separate acceptance.

Bounded directory entries and per-file parsing may return a captured subset, complete false for corrupt/unknown entries or exhausted bounds. Model bad is untrusted sync, not a producer write. No global atomic snapshot. Diagnostic names are hashed; this does not change captured records or completeness.

Two symbolic successor records share predecessor a and logical identity. Missing predecessor, invalid bytes, incomplete scan or two leaves prevent usable execution. accepted abstracts only this usable predicate, not global ready: missing automation/report or other findings may still require attention.

run and receipt assurance reported, even with producer verified delivery reference. Clock comparison adds explicit stale flag/finding while historical reported execution remains. Boolean staleInput abstracts exact age arithmetic; no real clock guarantee. Run timing.observedAt is another sourceTimes age input; actualTiming retains supplied fields or explicit nulls. Timing timestamp ordering and measurement truth are outside TLC.
Validated records and collision-free canonical digest identity are assumed. Parser rules and content schema are behavioral controls, not exhaustively proved by TLC.

Pure predecessor validation before publication and aggregate usable projection. Terminal execution cannot change on same-key successor; verified receipt cannot regress. Same-terminal attachments permitted. Subject and occurrence binding are additionally guarded but outside this finite transition model.

Expected occurrence with no observed run retains execution not-inferred, never completed. CreateRun is an explicit producer supplied claim and is never inferred from the slot. Empty inventory and enabled definitions without observed invocations also require observation attention in executable controls; no synthetic run is created. Global health summaries remain outside this finite transition model.

Synchronous lexical credential rejection during validateRecord. Exact source closure pin only; not a TLA secrecy theorem. assertExportSafe and validateArtifactLinks are cloud-export behavioral controls outside this local immutable-store model.

Pure generic report parser beside existing improvement-report validation, with nullable original sourceWindow. Exact source closure pin only; exhaustive parser truth and availability behavior are outside TLC. sourceTimes omits absent sourceWindow while retaining supplied generatedAt age.

Pure projection over captured immutable current records. Caller-supplied controlAuthority must match expectation namespace/automationId. Exact original registration digest, owner, target, usable original/latest, scheduling fingerprint, recorded-clock order and due/grace identity form dependency. Current disabled/edited configuration withdraws at or after effectiveAt; prior changed slots remain unknown. Freshness and complete-scan predicates gate applicability. Only a validated producer own occurrence with exact nominal timestamp and no explicit manual or scheduled-unbound report correlates a candidate. Early report-null runs can be observed independently of execution or report availability. State observation-gap is strictly after due; execution remains not-inferred regardless of any real reported run. Latest missing/conflicted/invalid leaf abstracts unusable. Source predicate arithmetic and parser domains remain bounded source controls, not exhaustive TLC enumeration.

Pure synchronous exact control-envelope validation and bounded recurrence membership supply validated/slot predicates. Exact source dependency closure is copied for every old and new witness. Source witnesses retain strict recordedAt-before-slot and fingerprint rejection. TLC assumes collision-free digests, validated records and faithfully computed recurrence membership; it does not prove all RRULEs, schema strings, timezone truth or acquisition.

One validated same-identity predecessor and successor abstract pure attachment/carry guards. priorReport distinguishes null, producer and retrospective. Exact prior digest, terminal basis, original record clock equality and observation/window no later than basis are Boolean predicates. metadataStable abstracts exact coverage and canonical timing/telemetry equality. sameReport is canonical whole-report equality; sameSummary is weaker summary equality used only by a mutant. Acceptance means predecessor usability, not global ready, source truth or authorization. Existing RunTransitions independently covers terminal execution; publisher awaits remain unchanged.

outcomeSourceTimes supplies original observedAt, original recordedAt and sourceWindow.end only. aggregate compares each supplied original clock to configured maximum age, preserving old evidence despite new report/wrapper clocks. Finite originalClock classes old, fresh and unknown abstract the oldest supplied original clock after validated UTC parsing; fresh includes exact age equality. Actual-source controls check equality and one millisecond beyond, old windows and null clocks. Full UTC parsing and arithmetic are not exhaustively enumerated by TLC.

Recorded run and receipt claims never establish independent execution/delivery authentication.
Stale captured records retain an explicit stale signal.
Non-unknown expectation classification requires the explicit caller-configured control role.
Non-unknown expectation classification requires actual configured recurrence membership.
Non-unknown classification requires exact original registration target.
Non-unknown classification requires same control namespace and automation owner.
Non-unknown classification requires its exact valid original registration dependency.
Incomplete or unusable captured dependencies cannot classify a current expectation.
Disabled or edited current configurations withdraw slots at or after effective observation.
Stale registration evidence cannot classify a slot as expected, observed or observation-gap.
A different scheduled slot cannot satisfy this expectation.
A manual run cannot satisfy a scheduled expectation.
An expectation never infers execution completed.
Elapsed observation grace never infers execution failed.
A fresh wrapper cannot make old or unknown original evidence fresh.

An attached scheduled-unbound report cannot be relabelled manual or downgraded to v1.
Scheduled-unbound outcomes never satisfy a nominal expectation.

assumptions: Collision-free digests; complete writes contain exact requested bytes.
Atomic same-filesystem hard links; ordinary immutable canonical files and fresh unique pending names.
No external deletion or mutation of already-published producer bytes; corrupt sync is separate untrusted input.
Successful operations and duplicate hard-link collisions only; arbitrary I/O errors and power-loss durability excluded.
Finite bounded exploration; no fairness, liveness, unbounded record count or global snapshot promise.
Expectation model receives validated schema, correctly computed recurrence membership and collision-free exact original registration identity.

Caller control-role configuration is trusted as local intended role selection, not independently authenticated ownership. Source freshness uses supplied original observation clocks and configured age, not verified provider truth.
One captured expectation read over bounded pure predicates abstracts current leaf conflict/validity and source acquisition; omitted external history remains unverified.

UnboundOutcome receives schema-valid reports and exact identity/predecessor lookup. Supplied clock classes are relative to one configured evaluation clock, not measured provider time. Equality predicates faithfully represent canonical metadata/report comparisons; retained bytes remain immutable.
excluded: Independent truth, provider execution, external effects, delivery, native IDs/ownership, schedule firing, deployment and cloud adoption.
Exact occurrence/report correlation and receipt causal-clock schema; separately driven by behavioral tests.
Complete parser validation, telemetry measurement truth, hostile OS ownership, symlink races and arbitrary I/O failures.
CLI option parsing, pagination, dashboard rendering, native sync and notification.
Run timing schema/ordering validation, real start/end/heartbeat truth and live process liveness. Timing observation age alone maps to staleInput.
Known credential lexical pattern coverage, cloud export selection/sanitization and arbitrary secrecy guarantees.
Generic outcome parser full input domain, availability projection semantics, sourceWindow completeness and producer report truth.
Concise summary/detail projection, scoped input filters, finding pagination and validate/dry-run namespace/predecessor preflight IO.

Expectation recurrence expansion full input domain, binding snapshots, controller acquisition/reconciliation, real current cloud definition truth, nominal-slot metadata, future scheduling and provider execution. Caller role configuration is an assumption, not authentication.

scopeReadView selects a read-only owner/dependency closure after full aggregate classification. Scoped filtering, health summaries and CLI pagination remain behavioral checks outside the bounded expectation projection.

Unbound attestedBy identity and permission, source truth, full parser/UTC arithmetic, source acquisition, transport basis remapping, sanitized export and UI remain separate behavioral or external gates. One predecessor/successor does not prove arbitrary history completeness.
